terms.definitionEn: An author-defined CSS value token whose name begins with two hyphens.
terms.definitionAr: قيمة CSS بيحددها الكاتب واسمها بيبدأ بشرطتين.

terms.definitionEn: A substitution function that inserts the value of a declared custom property.
terms.definitionAr: دالة إحلال بتحط قيمة property مخصصة متعرفة قبل كده.

terms.definitionEn: A pseudo-class matching the top-level element in a document tree.
terms.definitionAr: pseudo-class بتختار العنصر الأعلى في شجرة المستند.

terms.definitionEn: A math function that combines compatible CSS values using arithmetic operators.
terms.definitionAr: دالة حساب بتجمع قيم CSS متوافقة باستخدام معاملات حسابية.

terms.definitionEn: A value supplied after a comma for use when a referenced custom property is missing or invalid at substitution time.
terms.definitionAr: قيمة بعد الفاصلة بتستخدم لو الـ custom property المشار ليها مش موجودة أو غير صالحة وقت الإحلال.

terms.definitionEn: A comparison function that returns the lowest of its compatible arguments.
terms.definitionAr: دالة مقارنة بترجع أقل قيمة من مدخلاتها المتوافقة.

terms.definitionEn: A comparison function that returns the greatest of its compatible arguments.
terms.definitionAr: دالة مقارنة بترجع أعلى قيمة من مدخلاتها المتوافقة.

terms.definitionEn: A sizing function that constrains a preferred value between a lower and upper bound.
terms.definitionAr: دالة حجم بتحصر قيمة مفضلة بين حد أدنى وحد أقصى.

terms.definitionEn: The behavior by which some values pass from a parent element to descendants unless overridden.
terms.definitionAr: سلوك بتنتقل فيه قيم معينة من العنصر الأب لأبنائه لو ما اتعملهاش override.

terms.definitionEn: The value produced after declared values and dependencies have been resolved for an element.
terms.definitionAr: القيمة الناتجة بعد حل القيم المعلنة والاعتماديات الخاصة بالعنصر.

terms.definitionEn: The optional substitution branch used when the referenced token cannot provide a usable value.
terms.definitionAr: فرع إحلال اختياري بيتستخدم لما القيمة المشار ليها ما تنفعش وقت الاستخدام.

terms.definitionEn: The category of a CSS value, such as length or number, which determines whether operations can be combined.
terms.definitionAr: فئة قيمة CSS زي طول أو رقم، وبتحدد إذا العمليات ينفع تتجمع مع بعض.

questions.question: What does the name --brand identify?
options: A built-in color keyword for matching links
questions.explanation: Names beginning with two hyphens declare custom properties that can be substituted elsewhere.
questions.explanationAr: الاسم اللي بيبدأ بشرطتين بيعرّف custom property ينفع نستبدل قيمتها في مكان تاني.

questions.question: When is navy used as the second argument?
options: Only when the browser is in dark mode
When the paragraph has no text
questions.explanation: The fallback is used when the referenced custom property has no usable value at computed-value time.
questions.explanationAr: القيمة الاحتياطية بتستخدم لو الـ custom property المشار ليها مالهاش قيمة صالحة وقت الحساب.

questions.question: Why is :root commonly used for shared custom properties?
options: It selects every element with class root
It prevents descendants from inheriting values
It matches the document's top-level element
questions.explanation: :root matches the document's top-level element, making its inherited custom properties available to descendants.
questions.explanationAr: ‎:root بتختار العنصر الأعلى، وcustom properties الموروثة منه بتكون متاحة للأبناء.

questions.question: What kind of operation is performed here?
options: The percent value is multiplied by two rem
The two values are concatenated as text
questions.explanation: calc() allows arithmetic between compatible CSS dimensions such as a percentage and a length.
questions.explanationAr: calc() بتسمح بعمليات حسابية بين أبعاد CSS متوافقة زي نسبة وطول.

questions.question: What color value is substituted for the button?
questions.explanation: The declared custom property supplies coral to the var() reference.
questions.explanationAr: الـ custom property المعلنة بتوفر قيمة coral لمكان var().

questions.prompt: Declare a shared spacing token named --space.
questions.explanation: Custom property names begin with two hyphens.
questions.explanationAr: أسماء custom properties بتبدأ بشرطتين.

questions.prompt: Use the declared --accent value for this link.
questions.explanation: var() substitutes a declared custom property value.
questions.explanationAr: var() بتحط قيمة custom property المعلنة.

questions.question: Can the card use a custom property declared on :root?
options: No, values only work in the same rule block
Only if the card is a direct child of html
No, custom properties cannot supply colors
questions.explanation: Custom properties ordinarily inherit, so descendants can reference a value declared on an ancestor.
questions.explanationAr: custom properties غالبًا بتتورث، فالأبناء يقدروا يستخدموا قيمة معلنة عند ancestor.

questions.question: Why can the subtraction combine these two values?
options: Both operands must be unitless numbers
They are compatible CSS value types
The percent is interpreted as a color channel
calc() removes all units before addition
questions.explanation: CSS math can combine a percentage with a length for width calculations.
questions.explanationAr: حسابات CSS بتسمح بدمج نسبة وطول في حساب العرض.

questions.question: Which width value is selected?
questions.explanation: 90% of 1000px is 900px, which is less than 60rem (960px).
questions.explanationAr: 90% من 1000px تساوي 900px ودي أقل من 60rem اللي تساوي 960px.

questions.prompt: Choose the smaller of the available width and 60rem.
questions.explanation: min() returns the lowest compatible argument.
questions.explanationAr: min() بترجع أقل قيمة من المدخلات المتوافقة.

questions.prompt: Set a preferred font size between 1rem and 2rem, using 3vw as the preferred value.
questions.explanation: clamp() takes a minimum, preferred, and maximum value.
questions.explanationAr: clamp() بتاخد الحد الأدنى ثم القيمة المفضلة ثم الحد الأقصى.

questions.question: Which value supplies the card's color?
options: The value is invalid because names repeat
questions.explanation: The card's own custom property declaration overrides the inherited value for that element.
questions.explanationAr: تعريف custom property على .card بيغلب القيمة الموروثة للعنصر ده.

questions.prompt: Use navy if --ink has no usable value.
questions.explanation: The second var() argument is the fallback value.
questions.explanationAr: القيمة التانية في var() هي القيمة الاحتياطية.

questions.question: Which candidate does max() return?
options: The value written first, regardless of size
questions.explanation: max() chooses the greatest of its compatible arguments.
questions.explanationAr: max() بتختار أكبر قيمة من المدخلات المتوافقة.

questions.prompt: Set the inline size to whichever is larger: 20rem or 50vw.
questions.explanation: max() returns the greatest compatible argument.
questions.explanationAr: max() بترجع أكبر قيمة متوافقة.

questions.question: What computed font size does clamp() choose?
questions.explanation: 3vw is 36px at this viewport width, so clamp() returns the 32px maximum.
questions.explanationAr: 3vw تساوي 36px هنا، فـ clamp() بترجع الحد الأقصى 32px.

questions.question: Which value is ultimately used for gap?
options: The declaration is invalid because fallbacks cannot nest
questions.explanation: The outer fallback is another var() substitution, which resolves to the declared 1rem value.
questions.explanationAr: القيمة الاحتياطية الخارجية فيها var() تانية وبتوصل للقيمة المعلنة 1rem.

questions.prompt: Subtract a two-rem gutter from the available inline size.
questions.explanation: calc() evaluates arithmetic expressions containing compatible CSS values.
questions.explanationAr: calc() بتحسب تعبيرات حسابية فيها قيم CSS متوافقة.

questions.prompt: Override the inherited spacing token for this card only.
questions.explanation: Redeclaring the same custom property on the card overrides its inherited value there.
questions.explanationAr: إعادة تعريف نفس custom property على البطاقة بتستبدل القيمة الموروثة فيها.

questions.question: How do custom properties differ from preprocessor variables?
keyPoints: They are part of CSS at runtime
var() substitution occurs during CSS value processing
questions.modelAnswer: Custom properties are declared in CSS and participate in the cascade and inheritance at runtime. var() substitutes their values when CSS values are computed, unlike many preprocessor variables that are replaced before CSS reaches the browser.
questions.explanation: Runtime cascading and inheritance distinguish these values from build-time substitutions.
questions.explanationAr: الـ custom properties بتشتغل وقت تشغيل CSS وبتشارك في الـ cascade والتوريث.

questions.question: What does a var() fallback do, and what does it not guarantee?
keyPoints: It is used when the referenced value is unavailable or invalid at substitution
It follows the first argument after a comma
It does not validate every use-time property grammar issue
Nested substitutions can be used as fallbacks
questions.modelAnswer: The fallback after the comma is used when the referenced custom property cannot provide a usable value at substitution time. It does not guarantee that the resulting value is valid for every property, so a substitution can still make a declaration invalid at computed-value time.
questions.explanation: Fallbacks handle unavailable custom-property values but do not perform general property validation.
questions.explanationAr: القيمة الاحتياطية بتحل غياب القيمة المشار ليها، لكنها مش ضمان لصحة كل استخدام للخاصية.

questions.question: What kinds of CSS values can calc() combine?
keyPoints: Operands must have compatible types for the operation
Some contexts allow percentages with lengths
Whitespace is required around plus and minus operators
questions.modelAnswer: calc() can combine numeric values and compatible dimensions using arithmetic, with the allowed combinations depending on the operation and property. For addition and subtraction, include whitespace around the plus or minus sign, and ensure the resulting type is valid for the property.
questions.explanation: CSS calculations are typed and must produce a value suitable for the property.
questions.explanationAr: حسابات CSS ليها أنواع ولازم ناتجها يناسب الخاصية، مع مسافات حول + و-.

questions.question: When would min(), max(), or clamp() be useful for responsive sizing?
keyPoints: They can express limits without a media-query breakpoint
questions.modelAnswer: min() and max() choose among compatible values, while clamp() keeps a preferred value between explicit limits. These functions can express fluid sizing constraints directly, though media queries remain useful when the layout structure itself changes.
questions.explanation: CSS comparison functions manage values, while media queries conditionally change styles.
questions.explanationAr: الدوال دي بتحكم القيم، أما media queries فبتغير التنسيقات حسب شرط.
